format: Raw SPI NOR image, 16 MiB, one file per architecture. Unused space and the overlay partition are erased (0xFF). Not a PhoenixSuit container, not a disk image with a partition table, and not a whole-device backup.
boot_chain: BROM -> SyterKit SPL -> OpenSBI fw_jump -> Linux -> BusyBox

layout.name: bootloader
layout.content: SyterKit SPL with an eGON boot header; loaded by the BROM into SRAM. Brings up PSRAM, then copies the three payloads below from their fixed NOR offsets into PSRAM row by row.

layout.name: dtb
layout.content: Device tree. Also carries the flash@0 fixed-partition table that the kernel uses for the rootfs and overlay MTD partitions.

layout.name: opensbi
layout.content: OpenSBI fw_jump, built for PLATFORM=generic with PLATFORM_DEFCONFIG=sun252i-f101. SBI firmware that starts the kernel.

layout.name: kernel
layout.content: Linux Image (arch/riscv/boot/Image). SquashFS root is mounted read-only from the rootfs partition.

layout.name: rootfs
layout.content: rootfs.squashfs (xz), written at its real size. Mounted as a read-only MTD partition by the kernel; not copied to RAM by the SPL.

layout.name: overlay
layout.content: Erased (0xFF). The JFFS2 partition that /sbin/init formats and mounts as the writable overlayfs upper, making the root filesystem persistent.

layout_notes: Read sizes are fixed: the SPL reads exactly 256 KiB for the device tree, 512 KiB for fw_jump and 6 MiB for the Image, then validates the DTB. A replacement payload must fit its reserved region; the SPL does not read the file's real length.
Payloads are packed back to back so that every offset stays 2 KiB aligned, and the same offsets are repeated as MTD fixed partitions in the kernel device tree.
The overlay partition is the last 1 MiB. Writing an image over it discards any changes previously persisted on the board.

images.description: RV32 build for the F101 C907 cores, ilp32d ABI

buildroot_external.note: The external tree that defines both board defconfigs, the SyterKit build recipe and post-image-nor.sh. It is a moving branch; the images may have been built from an earlier revision.

buildroot.version: 2026.08 tag plus commits; git describe recorded in each kernel banner
buildroot.note: The two images were produced by different Buildroot revisions, which is why their git describe strings differ.

syterkit.note: Pinned exactly by SYTERKIT_VERSION in boot/syterkit/syterkit.mk, so this commit is the one used for both images.

opensbi.note: The defconfig names a branch, not a commit, so the exact built revision is not pinned by the image. The commit above is the branch tip observed on 2026-10-10.

linux.note: The defconfig names a branch, not a commit, so the exact built revision is not pinned by the image. The commit above is the branch tip observed on 2026-10-10.

busybox.note: Version read from the BusyBox banner inside each image's SquashFS root, not inferred from the defconfig.

musl.note: Buildroot's default musl for the revisions recorded above.

toolchain.license: GPL-3.0-or-later, with the GCC Runtime Library Exception
toolchain.note: Read from the kernel build banner; this is Buildroot's internal musl toolchain.

verification.method: Offline analysis of the two image files only. Region boundaries were found by scanning for the last non-0xFF byte in each region; payload sizes and SHA-256 values below are those byte ranges. BusyBox, kernel, OpenSBI and Buildroot version strings were read out of the images themselves.
confirmed: Both images are exactly 16777216 bytes and their SHA-256 values match SHA256SUMS.
Every payload fits its reserved region with the margins in layout.
The offsets match both post-image-nor.sh in the external tree and the F101_NOR_* defines in SyterKit's boards/yuzukineko/app_sram/spinor-boot/main.c.
The 1 MiB overlay partition at 0xf00000 is all 0xFF in both images.
verification.not_recorded: No hardware boot test is recorded in this package. The board-level result for a given board and flash chip is not asserted here.
